title: Canonical fire detections joined to polygon units (one row per detection × level)

run_id.description: Deterministic run identifier derived from a hash of the config snapshot (and optionally a timestamp).

source_file.description: Relative path (or basename) of the raw FIRMS shapefile that produced this record.

sensor.description: Source sensor. Must be one of: viirs, modis.

level.description: Polygon level name supplied in config (user-defined).

unit_id.description: Authoritative unit identifier (stringified) from the polygon level join.

acq_datetime_utc.description: Acquisition datetime in UTC. Composed from raw acq_date + acq_time and normalised.

yyyymm.description: Month key derived from acq_datetime_utc (UTC month).

date_utc.description: UTC date key (YYYY-MM-DD) derived from acq_datetime_utc.

conf_cat.description: Confidence category, harmonised across sensors: l=low, n=nominal, h=high.

frp_mw.description: Fire Radiative Power in MW for this detection (raw FRP field after type coercion).

daynight.description: Day/night flag if available (D or N). Null if absent in input.

satellite.description: Satellite/platform identifier if present in input; stored as string. Null if absent.

type.description: Raw FIRMS TYPE code retained in canonical detections after source-column mapping. TYPE == 0 filtering is applied before deduplication.

dedup_key.description: Deterministic deduplication key. Default: (sensor, acq_datetime_utc, round(lat,6), round(lon,6), satellite).

was_dedup_kept.description: True if this record is the retained representative within its dedup_key group; false if it was dropped.
